name: Fifty Ways of Looking at a Poem
BURNT UMBER BROKEN SILVER AMERICAN SPIRIT
I Saw It in a Dream
If You Could Do It All Again
little boxes on the hillsides, child
Mister Shifty and the Drifty Dudes
the spring begins with the first rainstorm
Time travel in a subconscious mind
